title: UK Single-Use Vape Rules in 2026: A Retail Listing Review
primaryKeyword: UK single-use vape retail listing review
searchIntent: Help adult retail and B2B readers understand the need to distinguish product information from UK-specific single-use-vape rules when reviewing listings.
sourceFacts: GOV.UK provides guidance on the UK ban on single-use vapes.
The guidance distinguishes product characteristics such as rechargeable, refillable, and replaceable components within its regulatory definitions.
Businesses need to check the complete GOV.UK guidance for how UK rules apply to their products and role.
jurisdictionBoundary: Keep all regulatory statements limited to the UK; do not generalize UK definitions to other markets.
prohibitedClaims: Do not identify any NEVEN product as compliant or permitted without evidence.
Do not treat a single feature as sufficient proof of a product's legal status.
